leer.text: Drop a JSON, XML or AASX file here. Metamodel 3.0 and 3.1 are read, export is always 3.1.

baum.loeschenText: The element and everything inside it will be removed. This can be undone.
baum.gleicherIdShort: Same idShort as a sibling element

inspektor.nichtsGewaehltText: Select an element on the left to edit its properties.
inspektor.keinAnhang: No attachment in the package under this path.

feld.idShort: Short name within the parent. Identifiables need not be unique here, their id counts.
feld.id: Globally unique identifier, usually an IRI or IRDI.
feld.semanticId: Reference to the ConceptDescription that defines this element.
feld.valueId: Reference to the value in a catalogue, required by constraint AASd-007.
feld.fileValue: Path into the package container, for example /aasx/files/manual.pdf. The content lives beside the model, not in it.
feld.blobValue: The content lives in the model itself and survives every export.
feld.observed: The element whose change triggers the event.
feld.dauer: Duration as xs:duration, for example PT1H.
feld.globalAssetId: Globally unique identifier of the asset.
feld.orderRelevant: Does the order of the entries carry meaning?
feld.derivedFrom: Reference to the shell this one is derived from.
feld.submodels: References to the submodels of this shell.
feld.preferredName: Plain name of the concept, at least in English (constraint AASc-002).
feld.definition: Technical definition, at least in English for IEC 61360.
feld.dataTypeIec: Data type per IEC 61360, not to be confused with valueType.
feld.unit: Unit as text, for example mm or °C.
feld.iecValue: Fixed value of the concept. Mutually exclusive with valueList (AASc-3a-010).
feld.valueList: Permitted values. Once filled, the property's value field becomes a choice.
feld.levelType: Which levels the value knows: min, nom, typ, max.

befund.leerText: The environment satisfies every constraint of the metamodel.

regel.AASc-002: The preferredName must be present at least in English.
regel.AASc-3a-004: For category PROPERTY or VALUE the dataType of the IEC 61360 specification is mandatory and must be one of the measure, count, text or time types, for example STRING or REAL_MEASURE.
regel.AASc-3a-005: For category REFERENCE the dataType must be STRING, IRI or IRDI.
regel.AASc-3a-006: For category DOCUMENT the dataType must be FILE, BLOB or HTML.
regel.AASc-3a-007: For category QUALIFIER_TYPE the dataType is mandatory.
regel.AASc-3a-008: A ConceptDescription with an IEC 61360 specification needs a definition, at least in English. Descriptions that denote a value are exempt.
regel.AASc-3a-009: For a measure or currency type a unit is required, either unit or unitId.
regel.AASc-3a-010: Either value or valueList may be filled, not both.
regel.AASd-005: A revision requires a version. No version, no revision.
regel.AASd-014: An Entity of type SelfManagedEntity needs a globalAssetId or at least one specificAssetId.
regel.AASd-020: The value does not match the given valueType.
regel.AASd-021: Two qualifiers share the same type. Only one per type is allowed.
regel.AASd-022: The idShort occurs more than once among the same siblings. For elements without their own id it must be unique, and case matters.
regel.AASd-077: Two extensions share the same name. The name must be unique.
regel.AASd-107: The semanticId of a direct child differs from the list's semanticIdListElement. Both must match.
regel.AASd-108: Every direct child of the list must have the type given in typeValueListElement.
regel.AASd-109: If typeValueListElement is Property or Range, valueTypeListElement must be set and all children must carry that valueType.
regel.AASd-114: Two direct children have different semanticIds. They must be identical.
regel.AASd-116: globalAssetId is reserved as the name of a specificAssetId. Its value must then match the globalAssetId.
regel.AASd-117: The idShort is missing. Only direct children of a SubmodelElementList may omit it, they are addressed by index.
regel.AASd-118: There are supplementalSemanticIds but no semanticId. The main semanticId is missing.
regel.AASd-119: A qualifier of kind TemplateQualifier requires the qualified element to be of kind Template.
regel.AASd-121: The first key of a reference must point at something globally identifiable.
regel.AASd-122: For an ExternalReference the first key must be a generic global reference, for example GlobalReference.
regel.AASd-123: For a ModelReference the first key must be an identifiable, that is AssetAdministrationShell, Submodel or ConceptDescription.
regel.AASd-124: For an ExternalReference the last key must be a generic global reference or a fragment.
regel.AASd-125: For a ModelReference with several keys, every key after the first must be a fragment key.
regel.AASd-126: For a ModelReference at most the last key may be a generic fragment.
regel.AASd-127: A key of type FragmentReference must follow a key of type File or Blob.
regel.AASd-128: After a key of type SubmodelElementList the next key's value must be a number, the index in the list.
regel.AASd-129: A qualifier of kind TemplateQualifier is only allowed in a submodel of kind Template.
regel.AASd-130: The text contains characters that XML does not permit, for example control characters.
regel.AASd-131: The AssetInformation needs either a globalAssetId or at least one specificAssetId.
regel.AASd-133: externalSubjectId must be an ExternalReference, not a ModelReference.
regel.AASd-134: The idShorts of all input, output and inout variables of an operation must be unique together.

muster.idShortMuster: The idShort must start with a letter, may otherwise contain only letters, digits, underscores and hyphens, must be at least two characters long and must not end with a hyphen.
muster.leereListe: {{feld}} is set but empty. Either at least one entry or none at all.
muster.spracheMehrfach: {{feld}} contains the same language more than once. One entry per language is allowed.
muster.zuLang: {{feld}} is too long, at most {{laenge}} characters are allowed.
muster.idShortFehlt: Every entry of {{feld}} needs an idShort.
muster.idShortsUneindeutig: The idShorts within the value must be unique.
muster.submodelsModelReference: Every reference under submodels must be a ModelReference to a submodel.
muster.derivedFromModelReference: derivedFrom must be a ModelReference to an AssetAdministrationShell.
